narrative: OMX30 faces a classic bull-trap setup: positive correlation from US strength (+0.8-0.9%) and firmer USD/SEK (+0.93%) support exporters, but technical deterioration is significant. The index sits +4.8% above its 200-MA yet trades -0.3% below the 50-MA, signalling momentum breakdown. Stochastic K=9.6 is deeply oversold and ADX's bearish DI bias dominates despite the 35.6 strength reading. Critically, US 10Y yields spiking 63bp to 4.975% compresses DCF valuations for the 40% tech/pharma/materials weight. VIX +11.74% to 17.7 shows creeping risk-off despite rally headlines. Watch for mean reversion in oversold stochastics, but don't chase without support confirmation.
morningBrief: Mixed signals dominate: US up 0.8-0.9% overnight and USD/SEK +0.93% should lift OMX30 exporters, but technicals are deteriorating rapidly. OMX30 prints -0.3% vs 50-MA while +4.8% above 200-MA—a bearish divergence. Stochastic K at 9.6 is oversold (mean reversion territory), RSI 34.91 is neutral-to-soft, and MACD below signal with hist=-8.982 confirms downside momentum. The real headwind: US 10Y +63bp to 4.975% crushes DCF valuation models for tech, pharma, and materials—40% of the index. VIX +11.74% signals underlying risk-off despite equity rally. Trade the oversold bounce cautiously; support is 3085 (lower Bollinger); if broken, target 3050. Watch 3123 pivot; resistance 3180 (50-MA) is steep. Key catalyst: US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET—big miss could trigger flight-to-safety.
